description: Stage 2 sees only its own nodes, although stage 1 built a `q` over the first token (engine §4.2 and §6, case 42).

documents.p.md:
```jbogenbau
%stage first
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text q r
%rule q A
%emits $
%rule r B
%emits $
%stage second
%ambiguity-resolution greedy
%rule text a b | q
%rule q C
%rule a A
%rule b B
%conditions $.preceded-by(q)
```
